metaDescription: Order custom 8 oz hot cold packs for your team or event. Perfect for first aid kits and employee wellness programs. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: 8 oz hot cold packs are a practical choice for first aid kits, employee wellness programs, and event giveaways. Their compact size makes them easy to store and apply to targeted areas like wrists or ankles. Decorate with your logo using screen printing for a soft, professional look that reinforces your commitment to safety and care. These packs activate quickly and maintain temperature longer than smaller options, making them a reliable addition to any workplace or promotional package.
